messages:
Renee Lopez: Partner asks for a Seller Credit model tied to early onboarding + a graduated commit smoothing program. need gating + who signs off on credits.
Gunnar Eriksen: clarify: seller credit = one-time invoice credit on conversion, not recurring discount? partner used the term loosely.
Renee Lopez: yes one-time, but they also want a monthly rebate if committed utilization thresholds are hit. two separate mechanisms.
Priya Singh: ops note 1: marketplace SKUs must be stable. if partner wants custom mapping we need a harmonization table and a deprecated-SKU notice period. recommend 45 days.
Tom (Finance): finance needs exposure controls. propose two limits: per-account credit cap and partner-total liability cap. also credits booked as contra-revenue in the month applied.
Sam (Legal): legal must lock renewal language & embargo. sample ask: explicit 3-year stepdown table and an "embargo until soft-list" clause. plus appendix for SKU harmonization and deprecation.
Gunnar Eriksen: technical: we can support both one-time credit and recurring rebate, but automation needs feed from billing and partner-provided usage stream. will need a reconciliation job.
Renee Lopez: partner also requests pre-list activation for a select set of pilot customers. can we allow pilots without exposing the private price publicly?
Priya Singh: allow pilots under NDA, tag accounts as `pilot-private-offer` and disable partner-facing public references. marketing should be blocked until soft-list.
Tom (Finance): for pilots: count usage toward committed bands if partner provides signed SOW and usage reports. require monthly reconciliation and a 30-day dispute window.
Sam (Legal): add clause: pilot activations count toward the commit only if recorded under the private-offer SOW and reconciled. also require partner indemnity for any misreported usage.
Gunnar Eriksen: ops plan sketch:
```
1) partner uploads SKU map CSV
2) eng-ops issues staging token for pilot activations
3) usage logged with token and `pilot-private-offer` tag
4) on listing, token swapped to marketplace SKU; audit events emitted
5) monthly reconciliation runs and triggers credits as per rules
```
Renee Lopez: credits mechanics we discussed: one-time seller credit applied on first post-conversion invoice (expires 60 days), recurring rebate paid quarterly based on committed utilization (with cap). both are contra-revenue.
Tom (Finance): propose cap options: per-account cap = min($75k, 10% committed ARR), partner liability cap = $500k. I'll run sensitivity and share a recommended cap.
Priya Singh: deprecation notice: partner asks for 30 days. legal recommended 60. can we meet in the middle at 45? Gunnar: 45 is doable operationally.
Sam (Legal): fine with 45, but include a contractual appendix stating a 45-day notice and migration assistance obligations. I'll draft redlines.
LaunchBot: Reminder created: marketplace-embargo-check/4222223333. Legal review due 4222300000.
Renee Lopez: action items: Tom to run cap models, Sam to draft T&Cs + appendix, Gunnar to produce SKU map template & token flow, Priya to coordinate NDA for pilots. reconvene tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar:
